clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren calls you north after Coleman Farthing's reckoning at Agamand Mills. The undead there threaten the settlement's northern border.

Coleman Farthing wanted revenge on his former neighbors, the Agamands, and sent travelers north to kill the undead around their flour mills. After you delivered the remains, Coleman saw that his private grudge touched a wider danger. The Agamand estate still crawls with aggressive Scourge minions, close to Brill.

Magistrate Sevren oversees Brill's civic and military security for the Dark Lady. Reports say you survived deep incursions into the haunted farmlands, and Sevren now directs you toward the source of the infestation: the ancient Agamand family crypt.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.
I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Coleman speaks well of you, friend, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.
The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
